facts.business: Varroc Engineering Limited is an automotive components manufacturer.

auditor.name: S R B C & CO LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to insufficient audit evidence regarding settlement offer from Beste Motor Co. Ltd. and TYC Brother Industrial Co. Ltd. alleging breach of Transition Management Agreement for income of Rs 209.89 million recognised from Chongqing Varroc TYC Auto Lamps Co., Ltd. Emphasis of matter on arbitration initiated by OPmobility Lighting Holding, France at ICC International Court of Arbitration and GST Appellate Authority orders against which appeals are pending.

key_risks: Arbitration proceedings with TYC Parties regarding breach of Transition Management Agreement and additional claims
Arbitration initiated by OPmobility Lighting Holding, France alleging breaches of covenants under Securities Purchase Agreement
GST Appellate Authority orders against which appeals are pending
Geopolitical uncertainties and trade tensions affecting automotive and auto components industries
Uncertainty around timing and pace of interest rate cuts across major economies
Commodity price fluctuations weighing on investment sentiment and trade flows
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
